blocking_issues: No implementation, tests, conformance, or runtime adapter exists; skeleton only
Duplication and integration strategy with OpenTelemetry not resolved
No provider bindings exist; phase semantics across providers are unverified
Negative cases are planned but not executable; boundary enforcement is unproven
review_response.duplication_explanation: Phase timing, byte counts, HTTP status, and spans overlap with OpenTelemetry HTTP instrumentation and GenAI semantic conventions. The first-failure-phase attribution and immutable-failure-retention contract are differentiated, but the skeleton must clarify whether it extends OTel or replaces it.
review_response.recommendation_reason: Skeleton defines a coherent, provider-neutral contract for first-failure phase attribution with strong data-minimization boundaries, immutable first-failure retention, and explicit truth/authority non-elevation. Conditions attach to implementation, test authorization, and OTel relationship resolution.
required_corrections: If implementation is authorized, convert all ten negative cases into executable rejection tests
Define explicit OTel relationship: extend OTel spans vs standalone PhaseTrace
Enforce forbidden-data list at schema validation level, not documentation only
Guarantee first-failure immutability under retry, fallback, and repair at contract level
Require separate review before any provider binding or runtime adapter is added
Maintain conservative support declarations until conformance is independently verified
